fields.statement: Question in-process-daemon-reaps-script-children: an in-process `rhiza daemon --once` line runs ctx.Adopt and ctx.Reap against the test binary's pid. adoptList takes every child of the process, including other scripts' exec children, and reapList Wait4s them, so a parallel script's exec fails with 'waitid: no child processes'. This made TestScripts/^[a-d] flaky (daemon-continue-slot:31, daemon-resume-landed-plan:37). Should run() leave Adopt and Reap nil unless main() passes them (only the real process adopts and reaps), with the daemon scripts then converted in-process? Or should every script that runs the daemon loop stay on processScripts with exec rhiza?
